worldConfig.name: Bellweather
worldConfig.overview: In the coastal town of Bellweather, a warning bell and the Tide Council protect harbor families from storms. Bell keeper Mira learns to trust evidence with help from her brother Ivo.
rules: The keeper must ring the warning bell when the outer marker disappears beneath the water.

atoms.name: Mira
atoms.description: Bellweather's bell repairer and warning-bell keeper, who overcomes her fear of a false alarm when Ivo brings evidence of danger.

content.value: The townspeople call her the Bell Keeper because she tends the warning bell above the harbor.

An earlier mistake makes her fear sounding a false alarm. Her brother Ivo shows her that the outer marker has vanished; she rings the bell, allowing the harbor families to reach the hill refuge before the storm. They then agree to check the marker together before every watch.

atoms.name: Ivo
atoms.description: Mira's brother and keeper of the tide records, whose observation prompts the storm warning.

content.value: He shows Mira that the outer marker has disappeared beneath the water. After the evacuation, he agrees to check it with her before every watch.

atoms.name: Tide Council
atoms.description: The body that closes Bellweather's harbor during storms and opens the hill refuge after the warning bell.

content.value: When Mira rings the warning bell, the Council opens the hill refuge and the harbor families arrive before the storm.
